disorder-name.detail: Antipsychotic medication-naïve first-episode psychosis patients; DSM-5 diagnoses: schizophrenia (n=51), schizoaffective disorder (n=21), bipolar disorder (n=4), schizophreniform (n=7), psychosis NOS (n=18), brief psychotic disorder (n=5), MDD with psychosis (n=2); entire group treated as a single FEP clinical cohort in normative modeling analyses
